description: Run a single-statement SELECT against the dataframes staged by the unhcr_get_* tools. Check a dataframe’s columns with unhcr_dataframe_describe first. Read-only: writes, DDL, DROP, COPY, PRAGMA, ATTACH, external-file functions, and system catalogs (information_schema, pg_catalog, sqlite_master, duckdb_*) are rejected. Optional register_as saves the result as a new dataframe with a fresh TTL. Recompute rates from summed counts rather than averaging rate columns.

preview.description: Rows to return inline when that should be fewer than the query materializes, e.g. a small sample while register_as keeps the whole result; a value above row_limit is treated as row_limit. Omit to return every row up to row_limit.

register_as.description: Save the result as a new dataframe under this name (df_ plus two groups of 5 uppercase letters or digits, e.g. df_ABCDE_12345) with a fresh TTL, to chain analyses. The name must not already be staged. The saved rows count toward the 1,000,000-row staging budget: the oldest other dataframes are evicted to make room, and a result larger than the budget is not saved.

row_limit.description: Most rows the query materializes (1–10000, default 1000). When more match, row_count_capped is true; use register_as to keep the full result.

sql.description: One DuckDB SELECT against df_XXXXX_XXXXX tables, at most 20,000 characters — joins, aggregates, window functions, and CTEs work. SUM and COUNT results come back as JSON strings (BIGINT); CAST(… AS DOUBLE) for inline arithmetic. Staged tables add origin/asylum UNHCR and UN region columns for regional GROUP BY.

name: unhcr_dataframe_query

attribution.description: Attribution UNHCR requires when these figures are reused.

providers.description: Third-party series in this result (IDMC, UNRWA), whose own conditions may apply.

source.description: Source to cite: "UNHCR Refugee Population Statistics Database".

terms_url.description: URL of UNHCR's Terms of Use for Datasets, to cite with the figures.

cap.description: The cap that bound: preview when lower than row_limit, otherwise row_limit.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_unavailable`: Dataframes are turned off in this deployment, or the SQL engine behind them could not load. `missing_table`: A df_<id> the SQL names is not staged: it never existed, its TTL expired, or it was evicted to make room for newer dataframes. `invalid_sql`: A statement starting with SELECT, WITH, or FROM does not parse, or the SELECT fails to prepare: an unknown column, table, or function, or an invalid expression. `sql_execution_error`: The SELECT prepared but failed on the data it read: a cast or conversion that does not fit, an out-of-range value, or invalid input to a function. `register_as_clash`: The register_as name is already a staged dataframe. `register_as_too_large`: The register_as result alone holds more rows than the 1,000,000-row staging budget, so it was not saved. `non_select_statement`: The statement is not a read-only SELECT: an INSERT, UPDATE, DDL, PRAGMA, or other write the engine refuses, or SQL that fails to parse and does not start with SELECT, WITH, or FROM (such as a misspelled SELEC). `multi_statement`: The SQL holds more than one statement. `denied_function`: The SQL calls a file-reading or external-data table function such as read_csv, read_parquet, or glob. `plan_operator_not_allowed`: The query plan uses an operator outside the read-only allowlist, such as the range() or generate_series() table functions. `system_catalog_access`: The SQL references a system catalog (information_schema, pg_catalog, sqlite_master, duckdb_*). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

evicted.description: Older dataframes dropped, oldest first, to keep the staged total within the 1,000,000-row budget once register_as saved this result; they can no longer be queried. Present only when any were evicted.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry of the new dataframe, when register_as was set.

notice.description: Guidance when the query returned no rows or rows were withheld.

registered_as.description: The new dataframe, when register_as was set.

row_count.description: Rows the query produced, up to row_limit. When row_count_capped is true this is the cap, not the full size.

row_count_capped.description: True when more rows matched than row_limit allowed through.

rows.description: Result rows, one object per row keyed by column name, bounded by preview and row_limit. BIGINT values (SUM, COUNT) arrive as strings.

truncated.description: True when rows were withheld by a cap.

title: Query staged dataframes
